# Onis
Large, horned people that come in a variety of colors. Their accuracy with guns is terrible, but their physical strength brings them a lot of boons both in and out of combat.
## Diet - Just about anything. Can even eat many things raw.
## Benefits - They take [color=#1e90ff]15% less Blunt, Pierce and Slash.[/color]. - Does more damage in melee; 25% more Blunt, Slash, Pierce, Stamina, and Structural damage. - Due to their big size, they can easily carry and pull any other species.
## Drawbacks - Oni are unable to fire any weapons with accuracy, with reports of bullets managing to fire even behind them - They are harder to carry and pull. - They are bigger than Humans, making them easier to hit.
## Oni Naming Conventions
Oni typically use a naming scheme which features first and last names that originate from Asian cultures. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Tsutomu Urukiboshi - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Kira Miboshi - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Io Chang - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Kenji Suboshi - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Roranora Zoro - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Son Goku - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Baki Hanma
## Lore
For the Oni species, they have always had combat as a major focus in their lives. Originally created as a genetic offshoot of Humans designed to serve in combat roles, they would eventually find their own identity inside of Asian mythologies. Where as their namesake were known as spreading fear and disaster, most of the Oni species would foster a culture around bringing hope and justice.
